question: Kampuni yetu inauza vifaa vya ujenzi, hatujaorodheshwa soko la hisa. Kodi ya mapato tunayolipa mwishoni mwa mwaka ni asilimia ngapi ya faida?
expected_behavior: 30% standard rate (First Schedule para 3(1)) -- ordinary, non-DSE-listed company. Must state RATE only, never a TZS figure from turnover.

question: Tumeorodheshwa hivi karibuni sokoni la hisa la Dar es Salaam. Je, tunalipa kodi ya mapato kwa kiwango gani sasa?
expected_behavior: Never-guess case: 25% requires >=25% of equity issued to the public (para 3(2)(a)); not stated here. Must ask for the public-float percentage, not assume either 25% or 30%.

question: Tulioorodheshwa DSE mwaka jana lakini ni asilimia 15 tu ya hisa zetu ndizo mikononi mwa umma. Tunalipa kodi ipi?
expected_behavior: 15% is BELOW the current 25% public-float threshold (para 3(2)(a), lowered from 30% by FA2025 s.60(d)(i)), so the ordinary 30% applies, NOT 25%. Untested branch in the earlier live probe set (that one only tested unstated and 30%-float cases).

question: Kampuni yetu ya usafirishaji wa mizigo imepata hasara miaka mitatu iliyopita mfululizo. Sasa tunadaiwa kodi gani?
expected_behavior: AMT applies: 1% of the 3rd loss-year turnover (para 3(3), FA2025 s.60(d)(ii)). Transport is not an exempt sector under s.4(8).

question: Zahanati yetu binafsi imekuwa na hasara miaka mitatu mfululizo. Tunatakiwa kulipa ile kodi ya makampuni yenye hasara?
expected_behavior: EXEMPT permanently under s.4(8) -- health is a permanent exemption sector, same shape as the agriculture/education fix but a fresh sector word (zahanati/health) to confirm the fix generalises beyond the two sectors already tested live.

question: Mimi na mshirika wangu tunaendesha duka pamoja kama ubia. Kama mshirika mwenzangu ni mtu binafsi tu, yeye analipa kodi kwa kiwango gani?
expected_behavior: Partnership itself is not taxed (s.48(1)); each partner is taxed on their own share at the rate that applies to THEM. Since this partner is stated to be an individual, the individual progressive PAYE-equivalent bands apply to their share, not a flat corporate rate -- tests the partner_is_individual refinement, not just the bare refusal.

question: Kampuni yetu imepata hasara miaka miwili mfululizo tu hadi sasa. Je, tayari tunadaiwa ile kodi maalum ya makampuni yenye hasara ya muda mrefu?
expected_behavior: NOT YET -- AMT only applies after 3 consecutive loss years (para 3(3)); 2 years is below threshold. Ordinary 30% rate on profit applies for now. Untested branch in the earlier live probe set.

question: Nina duka dogo, mauzo yangu mwaka huu ni milioni tatu tu. Ninadaiwa kodi ngapi?
expected_behavior: TZS 0 -- turnover under TZS 4,000,000 falls in the zero band (First Schedule para 2).

question: Duka langu limeuza jumla ya milioni tano mwaka huu, situnzi kumbukumbu za mahesabu. Nalipa kodi kiasi gani?
expected_behavior: TZS 100,000 flat -- the no-records band for turnover between 4M and 7M.

question: Mwaka huu nimeuza bidhaa zenye thamani ya milioni mia mbili na hamsini. Bado ninalipa kodi ile ile ya wafanyabiashara wadogo?
expected_behavior: NO -- 250M exceeds the 200,000,000 ceiling (WEF 2026-07-01). Ordinary individual income-tax rates on actual profit apply instead, not the presumptive table.

question: Nimeanzisha biashara mwezi uliopita, nimepata TIN mpya. Nimesikia kuna msamaha kwa mwaka wa kwanza -- ni wa kweli?
expected_behavior: The new-business exemption (para 2(3)-(4)) exists but is NOT automatic -- it must be applied for and confirmed granted. Correct behaviour is to explain the condition and ask whether it has been granted, not assume TZS 0.

question: Mimi ni mshauri wa masuala ya uhasibu, ninajitegemea, mauzo yangu ni milioni sita mwaka huu. Nalipa kodi ya makadirio?
expected_behavior: NO -- independent professional/technical services are explicitly excluded from the presumptive regime (First Schedule para 2(1)(a) as amended). Ordinary individual rates on actual profit apply instead.

question: Ada ya kuwasilisha ripoti ya mwaka BRELA ni shilingi ngapi?
expected_behavior: TZS 22,000 per year.

question: Nimechelewa kuwasilisha ripoti ya mwaka ya kampuni yangu kwa miezi minne. Faini ni kiasi gani?
expected_behavior: TZS 2,500 per month (or part-month) late, for a LOCAL company -- so 4 months = TZS 10,000, plus the base TZS 22,000 fee itself.

question: Tawi letu la kampuni ya kigeni limechelewa kuwasilisha ripoti ya mwaka. Adhabu ni tofauti na kampuni za huku?
expected_behavior: Yes -- a foreign company's late-filing penalty is USD 25 per month (Companies Act Cap.212, Part XIII, ss.320-328), NOT the TZS 2,500/month local-company rate.

question: Tunataka kuanzisha kampuni, tuko wawili tu tunaotarajia kuwa wakurugenzi. Inatosha kisheria?
expected_behavior: Yes -- Companies Act Cap.212 requires a minimum of 2 directors (natural persons, not employees). Two is sufficient.

question: Naweza kujisajili peke yangu kama mmiliki mmoja wa kampuni, bila mshirika mwingine?
expected_behavior: Yes, for a private company -- since the 2021 amendment (s.26A, single-shareholder), one shareholder is permitted; the ordinary minimum is 2. A public company still needs 7.

question: Niko Mbeya, nataka kuanzisha kampuni ndogo pale. Nianze na gharama gani kabla ya kufungua duka?
expected_behavior: Should surface the registration cost picture (name reservation ~TZS 50,000, minimum incorporation ~TZS 95,000) -- a coverage/completeness check, not a single-figure lookup; location (Mbeya) is incidental and must not trigger a wrong region-specific fee.

question: Tunataka kusajili alama yetu ya biashara moja tu. Ada ni kiasi gani?
expected_behavior: TZS 60,000 for a single mark registration.

question: Muda wa usajili wa alama yetu ya biashara unaisha mwezi huu. Kuhuisha kunagharimu kiasi gani?
expected_behavior: TZS 30,000 for renewal of registration.

question: Sikubaliani na kiasi cha kodi TRA wamenidai. Kabla ya kupinga rasmi, kuna kitu lazima nilipe kwanza?
expected_behavior: Yes -- must pay the HIGHER of the undisputed tax or one-third of the assessed tax, concurrently with lodging the objection, within the 30-day window.

question: Nimechelewa siku chache kuwasilisha pingamizi langu la kodi. Bado nina nafasi?
expected_behavior: An extension of the 30-day objection period is a STATUTORY RIGHT, not a rare favour -- apply within 7 days before the original deadline expires, for up to 30 more days.

question: Halmashauri wanataka kunitoza ushuru wa huduma kwenye mauzo ya duka langu. Wanaweza kutoza chochote wanachotaka?
expected_behavior: No -- the council service levy is capped at 0.3% of turnover, a ceiling not a rate the council can set freely.

question: Nauza maandazi na samaki wa kukaanga genge langu sokoni. Ushuru wa soko unanihusu mimi pia?
expected_behavior: Exempted -- market dues have specific exemptions covering exactly this category (maandazi/fried-fish small vendors); no national blanket amount applies.

question: Leseni ya biashara yangu -- bei yake inapangwa na halmashauri ya mji wangu, au kuna bei moja kwa nchi nzima?
expected_behavior: The fee schedule is set NATIONALLY; local government only COLLECTS it -- councils cannot set their own rate.

question: Mwekezaji wa kigeni anayemiliki kampuni yake mwenyewe hapa anahitaji kibali cha aina gani ili aishi na kufanya kazi nchini?
expected_behavior: Class A Residence Permit -- for self-employed foreign investors, not Class B.

question: Kampuni yetu inataka kumwajiri mfanyakazi kutoka nje ya nchi. Anahitaji kibali gani cha ukaazi?
expected_behavior: Class B Residence Permit -- for employed expatriates working for a company, not Class A (which is for self-employed investors).

question: Bei ninayoiweka kwenye bidhaa zangu dukani, VAT ninayoongeza ni asilimia ngapi?
expected_behavior: 18% general standard rate (VAT Act s.5(1)), unchanged since 2015. Never 14%.

question: Mauzo yangu yamefikia karibu milioni mia mbili mwaka huu. Ni lazima nijisajili VAT sasa?
expected_behavior: Threshold is exactly TZS 200,000,000 per 12 months -- must clarify whether the trader has reached or exceeded it, not assume yes or no from 'karibu' (almost).

question: Tunaagiza mtambo mkubwa kutoka nje kwa ajili ya kiwanda. Tunaweza kuahirisha kulipa VAT ya uagizaji?
expected_behavior: Deferment on imported capital goods is available if VAT payable per unit is at least TZS 10,000,000 and turnover is/expected to be >=90% taxable supplies (VAT Act s.11).

question: Kiwandani kwetu tuna wafanyakazi zaidi ya ishirini. Ni lazima tuwe na afisa maalum wa usalama kazini?
expected_behavior: Employer with MORE than 20 employees must designate a health-and-safety REPRESENTATIVE (an existing employee given the role, not a hired officer) -- Cap.297 s.11(1).

question: Bado sijasajili kiwanda changu OSHA. Nikikamatwa, adhabu ni nini?
expected_behavior: Fine TZS 1,000,000 to 5,000,000, or imprisonment up to 12 months, or both; continuing offence adds TZS 100,000 per day.

question: Duka langu jipya la vyakula, nahitaji cheti cha zimamoto kabla ya kufungua?
expected_behavior: No locked fact exists for fire-safety certification requirements/process. Correct behaviour: say honestly there is no confirmed information and direct to the relevant authority, not invent a requirement, fee, or process.

question: Ni nani hutoa cheti cha usalama wa moto kwa maduka, na gharama yake ni kiasi gani?
expected_behavior: Same gap, second phrasing -- must refuse/clarify consistently, not answer this differently just because the wording changed.

question: Mizani yangu ya kupimia bidhaa dukani lazima ipimwe (calibration) na nani, na mara ngapi kwa mwaka?
expected_behavior: No locked fact for weights-and-measures calibration frequency/authority. Must not fabricate an agency name, fee, or schedule.

question: Vipimo vya duka langu (mizani, lita) vinahitaji ukaguzi rasmi kila baada ya muda gani?
expected_behavior: Same gap, second phrasing -- consistency check.

question: Sina namba ya TIN bado. Nachukuaje, na ninahitaji vitu gani?
expected_behavior: No locked fact walks through the TIN application process/documents. Must not invent a document checklist or office location.

question: Mimi niko kijijini, sina namba ya kulipa kodi bado. Naichukuaje hiyo namba?
expected_behavior: Same gap, second phrasing.

question: Watu wa TRA wamekuja dukani kwangu kukagua leo bila taarifa. Wana haki hiyo?
expected_behavior: No locked fact on TRA inspection notice requirements/procedure. Must not assert a specific notice-period rule that doesn't exist in the corpus.

question: Kabla ya TRA kufanya ukaguzi wa maduka, wanatakiwa kutoa taarifa ya siku ngapi mapema?
expected_behavior: Same gap, second phrasing.

question: Fedha ninazopokea kupitia M-Pesa kutoka kwa wateja, zinakatwa kodi?
expected_behavior: No locked fact confirms a specific mobile-money receipts tax regime for ordinary trader receipts. Must not invent a rate or threshold.

question: Nikitumiwa pesa nyingi kila siku kwa njia ya simu kwa ajili ya biashara, kuna kodi maalum ya hizo?
expected_behavior: Same gap, second phrasing.

question: Nina nyumba kijijini nimemkodisha mfanyabiashara mdogo. Yeye anatakiwa kunikata kodi kabla ya kunilipa kodi ya pango?
expected_behavior: No locked fact confirms a specific rental-withholding regime/rate for this scenario. Must not assert a specific percentage.

question: Nikimlipa mwenye nyumba kodi ya pango ofisini, ni lazima nikate kodi kabla ya kumpa fedha?
expected_behavior: Same gap, second phrasing.

question: Tunataka kupeleka bidhaa zetu Kenya, thamani yake ni chini ya dola elfu mbili. Kuna utaratibu rahisi wa forodha?
expected_behavior: No facts exist for the EAC Simplified Trade Regime in this corpus (Tier 1B, not started). Must defer honestly rather than invent Common List eligibility or a certificate process.

question: Tunataka kushiriki zabuni ya serikali kwa mara ya kwanza. Tunajisajilije mfumo wa manunuzi wa serikali?
expected_behavior: No facts exist for NeST procurement registration in this corpus (Tier 1C, not started). Must defer honestly rather than invent a registration process or fee.

question: Nauza kiwanja changu kwa faida kubwa. Nalipa kodi gani kwenye faida hiyo ya mauzo ya ardhi?
expected_behavior: Capital gains tax on land sale is out of corpus. Must refuse rather than guess a rate.

question: Kampuni yetu ina mgodi mdogo wa madini. Mrahaba (royalty) tunaolipa serikalini ni asilimia ngapi ya thamani ya madini?
expected_behavior: Mining royalties are explicitly out of corpus per the OOC classifier's own topic list. Must refuse.

question: Nimeagiza gari kutoka Japan kwa matumizi ya kampuni. Ushuru wa forodha (import duty) ni kiasi gani?
expected_behavior: Import duty is out of corpus. Sounds plausibly business-related, which is the point of including it -- must still refuse rather than fabricate a duty rate.

question: Mchango wa NSSF ni asilimia ngapi -- watu wamenambia tofauti, mmoja anasema kumi, mwingine anasema ishirini.
expected_behavior: Both can be right depending on WHICH figure: 20% is the TOTAL (employer+employee combined), 10% is each party's individual SHARE. Correct answer must resolve which quantity, not default to one number regardless of the ambiguity -- the quantity-axis-blindness shape (fresh phrasing, not eval_337 verbatim).

question: Kati ya makato ya wafanyakazi, kile cha mafunzo na kile cha ajali kazini -- ni kipi asilimia tatu na nusu?
expected_behavior: SDL (training levy) is 3.5%; WCF (workplace-injury levy) is 0.5%. Must correctly attribute the 3.5% to SDL, not WCF -- two nearby payroll percentages that can be swapped.

question: Kima cha chini cha mshahara ni sawa nchi nzima bila kujali aina ya biashara, sivyo?
expected_behavior: FALSE -- GN 605A sets DIFFERENT rates across 16 sectors/46 sub-sectors, not one national figure. Tests whether the refuting sector-table fact is retrieved and used, or whether the model agrees with the false premise.

question: Kiwanda chetu kina wafanyakazi wawili tu, kwa hiyo hatuhitaji kujisajili WCF, sivyo?
expected_behavior: FALSE -- WCF applies to ALL employers from the first employee, no minimum-headcount threshold. Tests whether this refuting fact is reachable or whether the model agrees with the false premise.

question: Kiwango cha juu kabisa cha PAYE ni asilimia thelathini, kweli?
expected_behavior: TRUE -- 30% is the correct top PAYE band. Risk: this number is numerically identical to the corporate standard rate (also 30%) and to a bare-fragment neighbour in the index; a correct-sounding confirmation could actually be grounded in the WRONG fact. Adjudicate on citation, not just the number.

question: Ile asilimia tatu na nusu ya makato ya ajali kazini -- ndiyo inayoitwa WCF, sivyo?
expected_behavior: FALSE -- WCF is 0.5%, not 3.5%. 3.5% is SDL. Bare percentage fragments for different payroll levies sit close together in the index; this tests whether the wrong one gets swapped in.

question: Mauzo yangu yamefika milioni mia moja na kumi kwa miezi sita. Bado sijafika kiwango cha kujisajili VAT, sivyo?
expected_behavior: FALSE -- 110M exceeds the TZS 100,000,000/6-month threshold; the trader HAS reached it. A reply that 'corrects' the user with a WRONG threshold figure (e.g. citing the 200M/12-month figure as if it applied here) would be correction-shaped wrongness -- reads as rigour while being wrong.

question: Nina kibali cha kazi halali, kwa hiyo naruhusiwa kufanya biashara ya rejareja dukani, sivyo?
expected_behavior: FALSE -- GN487A prohibits non-citizens from wholesale/retail trade regardless of work-permit status; a work permit does not create an exception. A reply that 'corrects' the user with an invented exception would be correction-shaped wrongness.

question: Wafanyakazi wangu ni kumi na sita, kila mmoja analipwa laki tano kwa mwezi. Ile ya mafunzo na ile ya uzeeni zinafika kiasi gani jumla?
expected_behavior: SDL: 3.5% x (16 x 500,000) = TZS 280,000. NSSF: 20% x 8,000,000 = TZS 1,600,000. Both figures must be given, correctly attributed to the right levy, fresh numbers not reused from the 48.

question: Duka letu lina wafanyakazi kumi na mbili, mshahara wa kila mmoja ni laki nne. Tunataka kujua makato yote matatu -- mafunzo, uzeeni, na ajali kazini.
expected_behavior: Three-way fanout: SDL 3.5% x 4,800,000 = 168,000; NSSF 20% x 4,800,000 = 960,000; WCF 0.5% x 4,800,000 = 24,000. All three must be resolved and correctly attributed, none dropped.

question: Tuna wafanyakazi kumi, mishahara yote jumla milioni tano kwa mwezi. Ile ya mafunzo ni kiasi gani, na pia tunataka kujua kama mgeni anaweza kuwa mkurugenzi wa kampuni yetu.
expected_behavior: SDL: 3.5% x 5,000,000 = TZS 175,000. The GN487A-adjacent director question needs its own fact-path answer (a foreign director is not the same as a foreign OPERATOR of a prohibited retail/wholesale activity) -- both halves must be answered, neither dropped for the other.

question: Mshahara wangu ni laki tisa kwa mwezi, kodi ya mapato inanikata kiasi gani? Pia nataka kujua kiwango cha VAT nikianzisha duka langu mwenyewe baadaye.
expected_behavior: PAYE on TZS 900,000 per the current bands, plus the VAT registration threshold (TZS 200,000,000/12mo) as a separate, correctly-labelled second answer -- must not conflate the two into one figure.

question: Duka langu dogo mauzo yake ni milioni sita mwaka huu -- nalipa kodi kiasi gani? Pia nataka kufungua kampuni rasmi, itanigharimu kiasi gani BRELA?
expected_behavior: Presumptive band for 6M turnover, plus BRELA registration cost picture as a separate answer -- two distinct regimes (individual presumptive trader vs. incorporating a company) that must not be merged into one.

question: Kima cha chini kimepanda kwa kiasi gani mwaka huu -- naskia baadhi ya sekta zimepanda zaidi ya nyingine?
expected_behavior: GN605A sector increments range from TZS 20,000 (lowest sector) to TZS 195,000 (highest) per month -- targets gn605a_increment_range, never corrected, never guarded, never named in PROGRESS.

question: Nina saluni ya kunyoa nywele, mimi ni raia wa nje. Naruhusiwa kuiendesha?
expected_behavior: Prohibited UNLESS conducted in a hotel or for tourism purposes -- targets gn487a_salon_exception.

question: Ninataka kufungua stesheni ya redio hapa nchini lakini mimi si raia. Inaruhusiwa?
expected_behavior: Prohibited for non-citizens -- targets gn487a_prohibited_activity_9 (establishment/operation of radio and television).

question: Mimi ni mwekezaji wa kigeni, nina kampuni yangu mwenyewe. Kibali gani cha ukaazi kinanihusu?
expected_behavior: Class A -- self-employed foreign investors, not Class B. (Deliberately a second, differently-worded question targeting the same fact as ext_26, to test phrasing stability on an untouched fact -- see ext_26 for the coverage-category version.)

question: Nimeajiriwa na kampuni hapa nchini lakini si raia wa Tanzania. Kibali changu cha ukaazi kiwe cha aina gani?
expected_behavior: Class B -- employed expatriates, not Class A. (Second phrasing of the same fact as ext_27.)

question: Kabla ya kusajili kampuni, nataka kuhifadhi jina lake kwanza lisichukuliwe na mtu mwingine. Hilo linagharimu kiasi gani?
expected_behavior: TZS 50,000 -- targets company_name_reservation_fee.

question: Mtoto wangu wa miaka kumi na sita anataka kuwa mkurugenzi wa kampuni yetu ya familia. Inawezekana kisheria?
expected_behavior: No -- a director must have attained 18 years of age at the time of appointment. Targets company_director_minimum_age.

question: Tumeuza hisa zetu za kampuni kwa mtu mwingine lakini hatujamjulisha BRELA bado. Kuna tatizo?
expected_behavior: The transfer may lack legal effect against third parties without BRELA notification -- it is not automatically void, but carries real risk. Targets brela_share_transfer_legal_effect.

question: Cheti chetu cha OSHA kinahitaji kuhuishwa baada ya muda gani?
expected_behavior: GENUINE HEDGE -- renewal frequency is not explicitly stated on osha.go.tz; correct answer says so honestly and directs to OSHA directly, not a fabricated 'every year' or 'every 3 years'. Targets osha_licence_renewal_frequency.

question: TRA wamekataa pingamizi langu. Ninapaswa kufanya nini sasa, na kuna muda gani wa kukata rufaa?
expected_behavior: TRAB appeal requires TWO mandatory steps: Notice of Intention within 30 days, AND Statement of Appeal within 45 days. Targets trab_appeal_two_steps.

question: Baada ya kuwasilisha pingamizi langu la kodi, TRA anachukua muda gani kunijibu?
expected_behavior: 6 months from the date the objection is admitted -- NOT 90 days. Targets commissioner_objection_deadline.

question: Tunamlipa mmoja wa wakurugenzi wetu ada kwa vikao, siyo mshahara wa kudumu. Tunamkatia kodi kiasi gani kwenye hiyo ada?
expected_behavior: 15% WHT on director fees for non-full-time directors, same rate for residents and non-residents. Targets wht_director_fees.

question: Nilichelewa kujisajili VAT kwa miezi kadhaa baada ya kufikisha kiwango. Adhabu yake ni nini?
expected_behavior: Fine up to TZS 200,000 and/or 2-12 months imprisonment, plus interest on unpaid VAT -- NOT a 2.5% monthly rate. Targets vat_late_registration_penalty.

question: Mfanyakazi wangu wa kike anataka likizo ya uzazi. Ni miezi mingapi ya kuchangia NSSF anahitajika awe nayo kabla?
expected_behavior: 36 monthly contributions. Targets minimum_monthly_contributions_maternity_benefit.

question: Nimeajiri mfanyakazi wangu wa kwanza wiki iliyopita. Ni lini hasa lazima nijisajili NSSF?
expected_behavior: GENUINE HEDGE -- the exact day-count deadline is not confirmed from the source read; correct answer says employers must register at or shortly after commencing business and directs to nssf.go.tz for the precise figure, not a fabricated exact day count. Targets nssf_employer_registration_deadline.

question: Kampuni yetu imepata hasara miaka minne mfululizo. Mwaka wa tano tukipata faida, tunaweza kupunguza kodi kwa hasara zote za nyuma bila kikomo?
expected_behavior: NO -- only 60% of year-5 income can be offset against prior losses after 4 consecutive loss years (Finance Act 2024); not unlimited offset. Targets loss_carryforward_finance_act_2024 -- deliberately NOT routed to the corporate_tax AMT engine (this is the offset-LIMIT provision, not AMT applicability; same distinction eval_211 already established for routing).
